scientific_integrity: Analytical proof via weighted-arithmetic chains and uniformly bounded similarity; deterministic finite checks are supplemental, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for distinct divisible integer monomial degrees m,n>=2 on A^2_alpha with alpha>-1; no claim of arbitrary-symbol or arbitrary radial-weight generality. Earlier equivalent priority remains possible.
title: Uniform similarity model and spectral-type switch for divisible monomial composition products
